components.name: Masthead

components.name: PostList
components.summary: The home page: a reverse-chronological list of posts, each a date and a title separated by hairlines — no excerpts, no thumbnails, no cards.

components.summary: Article typography: the single column people actually read, all in greys with blue only on links.
